biggest_catch: Your payout is tiered ($10+$10+$10+$20) — you earn the full $50 per referred friend only if they open free checking, add direct deposit, apply for a TEG Rewards credit card, AND take a car/personal loan; most referrals will earn you less.
catches: Referring member earns tiered rewards per new member: $10 when they open a Free Checking Account, $10 when they add direct deposit, $10 when they apply for a TEG Rewards credit card, $20 when they apply for a car/personal loan — up to $50 per referred member.

All services must be added at the initial account opening except direct deposit, which must be confirmed in the account within 45 days; $50 minimum deposit in checking to qualify for the checking bonus.
No limit on the number of members an existing member can refer; limit one offer per new member.
Rewards are interest income reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.

TEG reserves the right to discontinue the program at any time without advance notice; membership limited to those who live, work, worship, or attend school in Dutchess, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Sullivan, Ulster, and Westchester Counties, NY.

steps: Download the referral form from tegfcu.com/refer-a-friend.
Have your friend fill out their section of the form.
Your friend brings the form to any TEG branch when they open their new account.

When the friend opens a Free Checking Account, you earn $10; when they add direct deposit (within 45 days), you earn another $10; a TEG Rewards credit card application earns $10 more; a car/personal loan application earns $20 — up to $50 per referred member.
